reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so paying ₹12,990 for Docketra when our two-person practice runs fine on spreadsheets and WhatsApp feels unjustified. I cannot see why I should pay nearly double for software when my existing routine costs nothing.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
would_change_my_mind: Pricing matched to Jamku at ₹6,500 a year and native WhatsApp integration so neither my clients nor I have to touch another interface.
